⌁ BreakPoint / Evidence LabMILESTONE 03
OBSERVE. DECIDE. ACT. VERIFY.

The browser has hands.
Now it has a decision loop.

A policy sees the current cart state and chooses one action at a time. The worker validates every choice. A separate replay verifies the result without asking the policy to grade itself.

Live OpenAI adapter implemented, not yet verified: no API key is configured. These saved runs use a deterministic offline mock policy, not an AI model. The hosted page does not execute the worker.

Run it yourself

python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r worker/requirements.txt
python -m playwright install chromium
python -m worker.verify_policy

# Run the offline loop
python -m worker.run --provider offline --fixture-directory dist

# With OPENAI_API_KEY and OPENAI_MODEL set locally
python -m worker.run --provider openai --fixture-directory dist

The live adapter receives only cart observations, enabled buttons, and action history. It never receives the fixture mode, source code, diagnostic panel, or test verdict. A live API run requires separately configured API access.
